messages:
maya: quick heads-up — int4-v3 shadow run (12h) results are in. short/medium docs look good (+0.5–0.8% ROUGE/MRR) but >2k token longdocs show a -1.2% reg and hallucination count up ~0.18%
aj: can you paste the slice breakdown?
maya: sure. short (<256): +0.5%, 256-2k: +0.6%, >2k: -1.2%. sample ~14k requests across slices. hallucination_rate change: overall +0.0018 abs (i.e. +0.18%).
samir: is this from a dedicated shadow pool or a silent production split?
lisa: shadowed traffic (2%), no user impact.
maya: thinking we should do a paired A/B (1% live traffic) with an automatic fallback. proposed auto-fallback if hallucination_rate_increase > 0.0015 abs OR MRR drop > 0.005 (0.5%) sustained for 30m. also add p99 latency increase > 0.01 (1%) as a safety net.
aj: +1 on paired AB. also add the min sample requirement and a rolling window (30m eval window, require >=2k requests).
samir: add token-prefix mismatch check — last quant experiment had small prefix loss causing degradation on longdocs.
maya: good call, will include prefix-mismatch metric. proposing the gate config I sketched below:
```
canary: {
  traffic: 1%,
  eval_window: 30m,
  promote_window: 24h,
  rollback_if: ["hallucination_rate_increase>0.0015", "mrr_drop>0.005", "p99_latency_increase>0.01"],
  min_requests: 2000,
  additional_checks: ["token_prefix_mismatch>0.0005"]
}
```
lisa: tiny nit — we store hallucination as per-request absolute rate; thresholds should be absolute (not percent-of-baseline). your 0.0015 matches that right? (i.e. 1.5 per 1000 requests)
maya: yep switching to absolute terms in config above.
canary-bot: plan created: `/canary create int4-v3 paired 1% --auto-rollback`
aj: please wire alerts to #eng-ml and to pager if auto-rollback fires. also emit a structured event to rollout_log with build_id and quant metadata.
samir: i'll run a focused manual eval on the longdoc holdout seed (200 queries) to check faithfulness + citation hallucinations. will post numbers.
maya: running eval now, will share results by EOD. build id: q1234-int4, quant config: nf4|bits=4|group=128. logged to rollout metadata.
lisa: when we promote, let's ensure canary metadata includes exact kernel selection and runtime flags (so we can repro perf/hallucination tradeoffs).
aja: (typo) aj: noted :)
aj: also set KPI delta smoothing to avoid noisy tiny blips causing rollback — maybe require sustained trigger for two consecutive 30m windows before hard rollback, but still alert on first window.
maya: agree — alert on first breach, hard rollback only after two windows OR an absolute safety breach (e.g., hallucination_rate_increase>0.003)
samir: thanks. once manual eval completes, we can decide whether to proceed with 1% paired or abort.
maya: updating thread with eval outputs shortly.
canary-bot: canary started at 1767000123
maya: thanks — I'll post eval numbers in a follow-up message.
